what-each-layer-owns.text: Singular owns registry transitions and NFT custody. Applications decide legal state changes. MPF supplies authenticated map mechanics.

names-that-must-stay-distinct.text: The representative NFT carries identity authority. Insert and Withdraw action tokens certify operations. Registry Update means retirement, while an application update changes local state.

registry-states.text: Absent keys may be inserted. Active means a representative is outstanding, including in a pending request. Over permanently reserves the key without a representative.
